definition.def: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.
examples: He has never been the most consistent of players anyway.

definition.def: If one fact or idea is consistent with another, they do not contradict each other.
examples: This result is consistent with the findings of Garnett & Tobin. [+ with]
New goals are not always consistent with the existing policies.

definition.def: An argument or set of ideas that is consistent is one in which no part contradicts or conflicts with any other part.
examples: These are clear consistent policies which we are putting into place.
